procedure: Resolve scoped source IDs to assessed originals.
Extract observations with exact meaning, classification and measurement basis.
Preserve table headers, cells, footnotes and original locators.
Return faithful evidence and targeted extraction/source exceptions.

acceptance.expectation: Each observation and table cell resolves to a source/version and original locator with period, unit/scale/currency, perimeter and inherited eligibility.
Transcription and paraphrase preserve original meaning, signs, definitions, table relationships and qualifications; missing values are not fabricated.
Actuals, attributed assertions, forecasts, proposals, judgments and fictional records remain distinct without inferred cause or approval.

conditions: Required source or execution tool unavailable
Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; identify affected record, evidence/test, consequence, next action and conclusion restriction
